name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
summary: ₹2 lakh life cover for a premium of ₹436 a year, renewed yearly through your bank.
description: One-year life insurance scheme, renewable every year, that covers death due to any reason.
implementingAuthority: Life Insurance Corporation and other life insurers through banks
